name: @gjsify/integration-loro-crdt
description: Integration tests: loro-crdt on GJS and Node. Validates @gjsify/webassembly Promise APIs + @gjsify/web-globals TextEncoder/TextDecoder + crypto.getRandomValues against wasm-bindgen-generated bindings (the canonical real-world consumer pattern). Loro is a CRDT (Conflict-free Replicated Data Type) framework distributed as base64-embedded WASM — no fetch/fs required at load time. Exercises LoroDoc, LoroText, LoroList, LoroMap, snapshot export/import, and bidirectional sync.

scripts.build:test: gjsify run build:test:node && gjsify run build:test:gjs
scripts.test: gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:node && gjsify run test:gjs
